items.t: NRB Monetary Policy FY 2026/27: policy rate, standing deposit facility rate and bank rate kept unchanged; CRR, SLR and standing liquidity facility provisions continue.
NRB targets 7% economic growth and inflation around 5.5% for FY 2026/27 and keeps the fixed exchange rate with the Indian rupee as the nominal anchor.
NRB will end the uniform lending standard for margin loans against listed shares; share and margin lending limits will be set according to the strength of each financial institution.
The weighted average interbank rate of banks and financial institutions remains the operating target of monetary policy; NRB will use open market operations to keep it close to the policy rate.
The unsecured loan ceiling for microfinance borrowers was raised to Rs 1.5 million.
NRB says it will closely monitor vulnerable banks and financial institutions under capital pressure.
NRB data for mid-January 2026: weighted average interest rate on deposits of commercial banks was 3.56% (saving 2.93%, fixed 5.24%, call 0.76%).
